# Disposable email domain snapshot

Source: https://github.com/disposable-email-domains/disposable-email-domains

Pinned commit: `c9c0f7b701001cd30382ed14701fcb4c87b76578` (retrieved October 11, 2026).

The JSON contains 9,226 domains from `disposable_email_blocklist.conf`.
Original list SHA-256: `f8540599dfb29904e56d38fd3e59a2e89b7da2f2ef11e227b8c72d7d8ef8fd60`.
Only this data and its license are vendored; no upstream code executes.

Review updates before replacing this snapshot. A domain list can be incomplete or
outdated; it does not replace inbox verification. The site provides a support
address for false positives. Match exact domains and their subdomains, never an
arbitrary suffix. Legitimate consumer email and privacy relays are not blanket
blocked.
